title: The total xanthones from Gentianella acuta alleviate acute myocardial infarction by targeting BRD4-mediated cardiomyocyte pyroptosis and inflammation.
authors: Dai, Cheng; Sun, Jiahuan; Yang, Gaoshan; Zhang, Chuang; Zhang, Yajing; Song, Qiuhang; Liu, Xingchao; Duan, Xuhong; Yang, Hongxia; Li, Aiying
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究龙胆科植物总山酮通过BRD4/TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3通路抑制心肌细胞焦亡治疗急性心梗，属纯药理与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gentianella acuta (G. acuta), a traditional remedy for cardiovascular ailments among the Ewenki people of China, has been reported to contain xanthones as its primary bioactive components. However, the complete chemical composition of G. acuta's total xanthones (TXG) and their therapeutic targets in the treatment of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remain inadequately characterized. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the chemical composition of TXG and identify its therapeutic targets in AMI, focusing on its role and mechanism in the suppression of pyroptosis-mediated inflammatory myocardial injury. METHODS AND RESULTS: UPLC-Q/TOF-MS/MS analysis revealed 29 constituents in TXG, including xanthones, flavonoids, lignans, iridoids, and coumarins. And 7 compounds (including 4 xanthones) in TXG can be absorbed into the blood. Xanthones, which constituted 68.1% of TXG's total content as determined by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), were the predominant compounds. Key xanthones identified included swertianolin, norswertianolin, bellidifolin, demethylbellidifolin, and mangiferin. Network pharmacology analysis, supported by qRT-PCR, molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experimental validation, revealed that TXG's anti-AMI effects are linked to the modulation of inflammatory responses. Key therapeutic targets identified include TLR4, NF-kappaB, and NLRP3, along with their associated signaling pathways. In vivo and in vitro experiments confirmed that TXG reduced BRD4 expression, thereby inhibiting TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling. This inhibition attenuated cardiomyocyte pyroptosis and inflammation, reduced infarct size, and improved functional and pathological outcomes in AMI. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that xanthones, the major constituents of G. acuta, are absorbed into the bloodstream and exert their therapeutic effects by inhibiting pyroptosis-mediated cardiac inflammation. The underlying mechanism involves multi-target inhibition of the BRD4/TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway, underscoring the potential of G. acuta in AMI treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：尖叶龙胆（G. acuta）是中国鄂温克族用于治疗心血管疾病的传统药物，据报道其含有氧杂蒽酮类化合物作为主要生物活性成分。然而，尖叶龙胆总氧杂蒽酮（TXG）的完整化学成分及其在治疗急性心肌梗死（AMI）中的治疗靶点仍未得到充分表征。目的：本研究旨在探讨TXG的化学成分，并识别其在AMI中的治疗靶点，重点关注其在抑制焦亡介导的炎症性心肌损伤中的作用和机制。方法与结果：UPLC-Q/TOF-MS/MS分析揭示了TXG中的29种成分，包括氧杂蒽酮类、黄酮类、木脂素类、环烯醚萜类和香豆素类。其中，TXG中的7种化合物（包括4种氧杂蒽酮）可被吸收进入血液。通过高效液相色谱（HPLC）测定，氧杂蒽酮占TXG总含量的68.1%，为主要化合物。识别出的关键氧杂蒽酮包括獐牙菜苷、去甲獐牙菜苷、贝利迪福林、去甲基贝利迪福林和芒果苷。网络药理学分析，经qRT-PCR、分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验验证，表明TXG的抗AMI作用与炎症反应的调节相关。识别的关键治疗靶点包括TLR4、NF-kappaB和NLRP3，及其相关信号通路。体内和体外实验证实，TXG降低了BRD4表达，从而抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路。这种抑制减弱了心肌细胞焦亡和炎症，减少了梗死面积，并改善了AMI的功能和病理结果。结论：本研究证明，尖叶龙胆的主要成分氧杂蒽酮被吸收进入血液，并通过抑制焦亡介导的心脏炎症发挥其治疗作用。其潜在机制涉及对BRD4/TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路的多靶点抑制，强调了尖叶龙胆在AMI治疗中的潜力。
